gen-fredoka-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain sans stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve. Fredoka's rounded, friendly display letters sit above it, so Synonym can stay steady while the heading does the smiling.
gen-fredoka-noto-serif: Noto Serif reads as a classic serif with a subtle thick-and-thin cadence and a prominent x-height, literary without stiffness. Fredoka's heading stays soft and monoline above it.
gen-fredoka-outfit: Outfit draws its sans-serif curves like bent cable, finishing well before they close. Outfit then carries a long passage smoothly beneath Fredoka's friendly, single-width heading, with no swelling to slow the eye.
gen-fredoka-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is a modern, precise plain sans, monoline, with curve endings kept well apart. And Fredoka earns its keep when set big and short, where its friendly pen line and open e can be seen.
gen-fredoka-sora: Fredoka leads with a friendly, single-width pen line and an open e that feels approachable at a glance. But Sora, a geometric sans-serif, does its best work in steady text, where its c and s stay widely parted.
gen-fredoka-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk builds each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, a geometric plain sans with counters that breathe. And a long passage in it moves along briskly under Fredoka's softer, rounder heading.
gen-fredoka-switzer: Switzer reads tall and wire-like, a Swiss-minded sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching. But Fredoka does the warm, rounded greeting in the heading, while Switzer handles the tidy, upright text.
gen-fs-array-fs-bespoke-slab: Array's large lowercase eyes and open-ended curves give it a futuristic look. Bespoke Slab, a grounded serif with tall lowercase bodies, is good for a handful of lines, and its size is the one to adjust.
gen-fs-array-fs-hoover: Hoover is a refined, robust serif with a generous entry into the e's eye and compressed ascenders. And Array's precise, futuristic curves give it a sharp counterpart, comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-array-fs-trench-slab: Array brings futuristic, open-ended curves and large lowercase eyes. Trench Slab, a dignified serif with almost no gap between x-height and caps, follows to make a compact block, built for short stretches of reading.
